  "list_replace list a b \<equiv> map (\<lambda>x. if x = a then b else x) list"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>primrec list_replace_list :: "'a list \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> 'a list \<Rightarrow> 'a list" where
  "list_replace_list [] a list' = []" |
  "list_replace_list (x # xs) a list' = (if x = a then list' @ xs
                           else x # list_replace_list xs a list')"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>definition list_swap :: "'a list \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> 'a list" where
  "list_swap list a b \<equiv> map (\<lambda>x. if x = a then b else if x = b then a else x) list"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>primrec list_insert_after :: "'a list \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> 'a list" where
  "list_insert_after [] a b = []" |
  "list_insert_after (x # xs) a b = (if x = a then x # b # xs
                                     else x # list_insert_after xs a b)"
